suites.name: Backend unit and slice tests
suites.description: Every backend test that needs no Docker. Testcontainers tests are tagged docker and excluded here. Line and branch coverage is collected with JaCoCo.

suites.name: Backend PostgreSQL integration tests
suites.description: Every test tagged docker (Testcontainers PostgreSQL) in all modules, including identity and catalog migrations.

suites.name: Order web unit and accessibility tests
suites.description: Vitest for frontend/order-web (components, API client, accessibility checks), with JUnit output. Runs on pull requests only when the order web app changes.
command: cd frontend/order-web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=test-results/TEST-vitest.xml

suites.name: API contract checks
suites.description: Checked Order/Catalog OpenAPI documents, problem and outbox-envelope contract markers (tests/contracts). The scripts write no JUnit, so EAHP records the exit code.

suites.name: Order web end-to-end tests
suites.description: Playwright specs for frontend/order-web against the Vite dev server with mocked API responses, including accessibility checks.
command: cd frontend/order-web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_OUTPUT_NAME=test-results/TEST-playwright.xml npx playwright test --reporter=junit

suites.name: k6 performance baseline
suites.description: tests/performance/scenarios.js (normal mix, idempotent replay, hot reads, optimistic conflicts) against a deployed environment; fails when the script's thresholds (checks > 99%, HTTP errors < 1%) are missed. EAHP records p95, throughput and error rate from k6-summary.json.
